Quirenote · design extension · brief #132 · implementing #485

The archive admin panel: coverage strips, two repairs and the run log, at /settings/archive

What GET /admin/archive/diagnosis answers, drawn from what it answers now: the shared price archive read READ ONLY with the diagnosis's own statements. A coverage strip per (instrument_ref, basis, source) group on one axis per source, with the empty days per source above them; the two repairs POST /admin/archive/operations starts, each behind a confirmation that echoes its parameters; and the run log in its four states. Every frame is a state the client reaches. The super-admin reaches the panel from a fourth card on /settings; nobody else sees the card, and /settings/archive answers NotFound to them (#485).

T1 · The entry: a fourth card, for the super-admin only

At the foot of /settings, after Appearance, in the Settings card recipe: the section label «Адміністрування», one setting row «Архів цін» with its helper, and «Відкрити» as an outline link-button, since the screen's one filled action is not here. The card exists only for the super-admin: how the SPA learns the role is #485's open choice, and until it knows, the card is not rendered, so no other role sees it arrive or leave. The sidebar is untouched; Settings stays the active pill on /settings/archive, the route being under it.

T2 · The panel, from the top and at full length

Header. A muted «‹ Налаштування» above the title goes back; below md it takes TAP_44's 44 × 44 hit area, which a static sheet does not draw. The action slot holds the snapshot's time and «Оновити», an outline header-size button, once there is an answer. The diagnosis waits up to 25 s, is throttled to one a second and executes the observe window's payloads, so it runs only on a press: «Прочитати архів» first (T3), «Оновити» after, never on arrival or a timer.

Figures per source, two KpiCards side by side at 1280, stacked at 360. The figure is emptyDays summed over the source's groups: days counted empty in whatever eras the source has (imported history is Inzhur's alone), the days its strips mark and, past a cut, count. It is in warn-tint-text with a warning glyph when it is not zero, and its line names in how many groups, and how many groups are not measured. Under a hairline, gaps summed, named for what it is, published days less days with a row: it nets, so a row on a day with no usable capture hides an empty one and the figure can go below zero (diagnose-reconciliation.ts:117-119); then bySource's captures and their gzip size.

The run log is read on arrival and after every start's answer, and again every 10 s while a row is pending or running, stopping when none is (the list allows two reads a second). While a start awaits its answer, a poll holds back rows newer than the press: the server records the run before it answers, and only the 202 names it. It is a table at 1280 and a stacked list at 360, newest first, ten to a page (limit=10; the route's default is 50); «Показати ще» shows only when the list answers next, so not for the few runs drawn. The four states are a chip each, a glyph and a word, never a colour alone: «Надсилається» (pending: the start sent, no answer yet; outlined), «Виконується» (info-tint, with the deadline under its start time), «Готово» (panel), «Помилка» (warn-tint: a failed run is a caution, not the irreversible harm neg-tint is kept for). A failed run shows its reason as a sentence, deadline_exceeded its own, and its message whole in mono under it, wrapping; it stays listed. A result reads per mode; complete: false adds «Не завершено — далі з …» in warn-tint-text. startedBy reads «Ви» when it is the session's sub, otherwise its first eight characters and an ellipsis, in mono; every drawn run is the session's own, a second super-admin existing only after the first is replaced.

Coverage, one card per source, each with its own axis (T4). A group is a row: the ref in mono and its basis in a hairline tag (16 tall, radius 4), the strip, and its count, emptyDays: «N днів» in warn-tint-text, a muted «0», or «не виміряно» when nothing was measured. The most empty days come first, then the order the route serves the groups in (by ref, digits and capitals before lower case), a group not measured last. At 360 the ref and count share a line above a full-width strip. The last three rows close the panel as a spot check: sample, the newest rows by as_of DESC, instrument_ref, with size, the stored captures' count and gzip size over price_capture alone (capture.ts:1232-1236, :1283-1290).

T3 · The read: in flight, failed, and failed on refresh

The two reads are independent, the diagnosis and the run log, and the forms read nothing. On arrival nothing is read: one card says the archive has not been read, why the read waits for a press, and offers «Прочитати архів»; the figures, coverage and spot check are not drawn, and the slot is empty. Pressing it removes the card, so focus moves to the busy «Читаємо» in the slot. The first read in flight knows the two sources and nothing else: the figures read «—» in faint, each coverage card and the spot check hold three panel rows, as first-paint.dc.html holds a list, with no axis and no legend; the slot reads «Читаємо архів…» beside a busy «Читаємо». The forms and the run log stay live. A refresh in flight keeps the answer on screen, the slot reading «Знімок … · оновлюємо…» beside a busy «Оновлюємо». A first read that fails, 502 or 504 (or any other answer, named by its HTTP status), puts one card in place of the figures, coverage and spot check, naming the code and offering «Спробувати ще раз»; with no snapshot yet, the slot is empty and the card holds the retry. A 504 leaves the capture reading to its own timeout, so its card says the read may still be running. A refresh that fails keeps the answer in hand on screen, as Not found and failures keeps one, and says so in the slot: the snapshot's time with the code beside it, in warn-tint-text. The run log's own read holds three rows in flight; a first log read that fails keeps its card with one sentence naming the status and «Спробувати ще раз», runs going on without it. A later poll that fails keeps the rows in hand (T6). A 403 on this route belongs to the router's NotFound (#485) and is not drawn. The failure cards are not Not found and failures' boundary states, which show no status code and refuse an in-place retry: that topic now says so in docs/DECISIONS.md, scoping itself to a screen behind /view whose read throws. These reads do not throw; what a card names is the route's error key, or the HTTP status where the route has none (the log's 500 and 429 are API Gateway's, keyless), which the one person who sees it reads to decide what to run next, and its retry is a new read, not a re-render.

T4 · The coverage strip

The axis runs from the source's earliest bound, the earliest imported, measured or listed empty day of its groups, to today, the same for every group of that source, so the strips of one card compare by position. The ticks are months over a span under 200 days, quarters under about two years, years beyond, a tick within 12 % of the end dropped so it never collides with «сьогодні»; the span and the group count are named once under the card's title.

The bands, 12 px tall, radius 3 (round(12 × 0.26)): the empty track is page; the captured era, from measured_from to last_as_of, is muted; imported history before it is info at half the height, radius 2, and meets the captured era at a 2 px card seam. The API does not serve imported history's first day, but it is derived: the imported era ends the day before the captured one begins (diagnose-reconciliation.ts:44-49), and for a group with imported history measured_from is that first captured day, so the era starts importedDays before it. A missing day from emptyDates is warn, at least 2 px wide, 3 px above and below the band, with a 1 px card keyline each side. The hue does not carry it alone: warn on muted is 1,17 : 1 in both themes and info on muted 1,08 and 1,01 (T8), so the keyline, the overhang, the half height and the seam do. A group with no captured era (dates 0) serves neither era's ends, so it draws no band, but its emptyDates are dates and its marks are placed on the track. Expected captured days stop at the group's last row (:54), so a group that has fallen behind reads «0» over an unmarked tail of track, the stretch «Дозаписати спостереження» or the next capture fills.

The cut. emptyDates is one ascending list over both eras, cut to its latest 100 (diagnose-reconciliation.ts:51-70, :121), so the oldest days go first, imported history's before the captured era's. When emptyDays is larger, the span from the group's earliest expected day to the first listed date is hatched in card, the first mark standing where the hatch ends, and a line under the strip says how many more there are and before which date. No group in the archive has more than 100 empty days now, so the cut is drawn at 4× only. A position the API neither serves nor lets be derived is never drawn.

T5 · The two repairs, their confirmation and their refusals

One card, «Ремонт», two forms side by side at 1280 with a hairline between them, stacked at 360 with a divider. Дозаписати спостереження re-reads the source's stored captures over the range and writes the observations they hold and the archive lacks; it fetches nothing, so a day with no usable capture stays empty (observeNbu, observeInzhur in capture.ts). Its fields: the source as a two-segment control (LanguageControl's track; sent as inzhur or nbu_fv), and «Від» and «До» as two DatePicker triggers, drawn holding the two days the archive's one incomplete instrument misses. Імпортувати історію фондів downloads each fund's published price file and writes every day it holds that the archive lacks (importFundHistory, ON CONFLICT … DO NOTHING); its field: one Switch per fund the route accepts, inzhur-reit and inzhur-energy, both on by default. Each ends in an outline «Запустити…»; the ellipsis says a confirmation follows.

The confirmation is the app's AlertDialog at 420 (the full width less 32 at 360). It says only that the start goes to the server with these parameters, the answer being the server's, and echoes every parameter the start will send in a page panel, the source with its wire name, and the range's length in days; its one filled button «Запустити» is the screen's only one. Pressing it closes the dialog and puts the pending row at the top of the log at once.

Refusals land at the form, and the pending row leaves. 405 operations_prod_only is every start's answer on dev, before anything is recorded, so dev's log is empty: an info-tint notice under the pressed form, in ReminderStrip's banner recipe (radius 16, padding 12 / 16), says starting is off here and what still works. 422 invalid_operation: each issues[].field the form owns takes a neg edge and its sentence under it (T9), and a field the form does not own reads as one form-level line. A 429, a 500, a 502 and no answer at all each put their sentence under the form (T9), the last saying the start may have arrived; a 500 may come after the run was recorded, and then the log shows it on its next read. «Запустити…» stays pressable while a start is pending: the route takes concurrent starts, and the confirmation is the guard against a stray one. A 502 start_failed names no run, its body being {"error":"start_failed"} alone (archive-operations.ts:142), so the pending row leaves as for any refusal, and the next read of the log shows the run the server recorded failed, «Не вдалося запустити.», or, when that write did not land (:316-325), the run reading «Виконується» until its deadline and then deadline_exceeded.

T6 · The run log before any run

Before the first start the card keeps its title and order note and says «Ще жодного запуску», with what will appear there, under a clock glyph. This is also dev's log, always. A poll that fails while rows are shown keeps them, the running one included, and says under the title when the log last failed to refresh and why; the poll goes on while a run is live. The full log is in T2: all four states, and the failures deadline_exceeded and capture_failed; start_failed is T5's.

T7 · The geometry, measured on this sheet

Measured on this sheet at file:// through the chrome-devtools MCP, DPR 1, behind a 100 × 100 probe that read 100 × 100; document.visibilityState visible; animations and transitions off; measured twice, the second run reading what the first wrote. 0 of 36 frames overflow their viewport; 0 of the 16 frames at 360 lay anything past 360. This machine lays a 1 px border out at 0,67 even under DPR-1 emulation (devicePixelRatio reads 1,0000000298), so a height that includes one, the 360 header bar's 56 + 1, reads a third of a pixel short, and Settings' top reads 753,24 where sign-in-entry.dc.html T5 records 753,25.

T10 · Refused, and not drawn

  • A sidebar item for the archive: the owner ruled for the card (header).
  • One axis across both sources, and a fixed recent window: the owner ruled for one axis per source.
  • A window switch on the strip («90 днів / Усе»): nothing asked for it.
  • Collapsing the groups without empty days behind «показати всі»: #485 shows every group with its count and strip.
  • Drawing missing days the API does not place: older than the latest 100, the span is hatched and counted.
  • Reading the diagnosis on arrival or on a timer: it reads on a press only, «Прочитати архів» and then «Оновити» (header).
  • gaps as the count beside a strip or the figure: it nets, so it can hide an empty day and go below zero.
  • A figure invented for the drawing: every one is the archive's or computed from it (header).
  • Matching a 502's pending row to a recorded run: the answer names none.
  • A second filled button: the confirmation's «Запустити» is the screen's one; every start on the page is outline.
  • neg-tint for a failed run: kept for overdue and irreversible harm; a failed repair is a caution.
  • pos for a succeeded run: gain and loss colours are for deltas only.
  • A start disabled on dev: the 405 is the server's answer to show at the form; the client does not guess the environment.
  • Editing archive rows, backfill and notifications: out of scope (#132).
